name: beav
summary: fullscreen binary file editor, supports insert and delete, OSK CRC calculation can display in hex,ascii,oct,dec and binary format; can edit multiple files, blockinsert, emacs-like command interface.
author: Peter Reiley (OSK extensions: Stephan Paschedag)

name: checksum
summary: calculates 16-bit (word) checksum over the specified files. The word checksum is used by most commercial EPROM burners. The main use of the utility is therefore EPROM burning/verification support.
author: Lukas Zeller

name: compress
summary: The compress program is compatible with the compression/decompression used on the Unix systems compress programs. This is version 4 and supports up to 16 bits compression.

name: dfiles
purpose: search for double files on disk
summary: One or more root directories are (recursively) scanned for equal filenames. If equal filesnames are found, an appropriate 'cmp'-command is issued (or executed).
author: Christian Mahr

name: disktest
summary: This program measures the read and write transfer rates for the current diskdrive (chd). In a second part the maximum and average seek times are caluculated.
author: Stephan Paschedag, CH-8708 Maennedorf
runtime: creates a large temorary file which is delete at program termination

name: etags
summary: ETAGS generates tag files used by editors like VI or GNU-Emacs ctags style tag files may be generated. ETAGS knows the syntax of C, Fortran, LaTex, Scheme and Emacs Lisp/Common Lisp
author: GNU (part of GNU Emacs)

name: Exception_handler
summary: Outputs the exceptioon information and also creates a data module with the information, thus allowing it's output at a later stage (useful if no attached terminal).
author: Alessandro Miotto

name: Exit_handler
summary: Allows user processes or packages to define routine(s) that need to be executed on process exit. This is done by adding to new calls to the kernel.
author: Alessandro Miotto

name: FCCTL
summary: status = FCCtl (mode)
author: Douglas Kemp

name: fgrep
summary: find strings in text files
author: from FREE SOFTWARE FOUNDATION (adaption to OS-9/68k : Stephan Paschedag)

name: fillup
purpose: fills up file with byte pattern
summary: fills up a file with a specified byte value up to a specified size. This is useful to enlarge binary files to be burnt into EPROMs to fit the EPROM size exactly (ensures reproducable checksum)
author: Lukas Zeller

name: flex
summary: creates C-source from a lexical analyzer description language
author: Vern Paxson

name: FPERMIT
purpose: C Interface to F$Permit, F$Protect and F$GSPUMp
summary: status = FPermit (addr,size,permission) status = FProtect (addr, size) status = FGSPUMp (procid, addr, size)
author: Douglas Kemp

name: help
summary: The advanced HELP utility offers structured access to all type of help texts in OS-9/68k systems. The program replaces the standard utility called "help".
author: Lukas Zeller
runtime: CMDS/help         The help utility CMDS/helpindex    Index file creator utility SYS/HELP/help.hlp The help file for help itself (=documentation) SYS/HELP/*.hlp    Additional help files SYS/HELP/*.hlib   Additional help libraries

name: hexed
summary: generates hexdump from binary data file, uses standard texteditor to modify dump, then retransforms dump to binary data again
author: Helmut Hoheisel-Zimmermann, D-2300 Kiel 14
runtime: uses /r0 for temporary files; may be changed using -t-option

name: hist
summary: This program simulates the 'history'-feature of the BSD-UNIX C-shell. Furthermore a commandline editor gives a bit more comfort in correcting and modifying than 'erase by backspacing'.
hardware: ready to go for Steinmann & Frei's emulation of Wyse-50 terminal on mc68000; may be recompiled for original terminal driver of mc68000 with 2. makefile; may be adapted for any other system and terminal by editing the include files 'h_def.h' and 'h_edidef.h'.
author: Helmut Hoheisel-Zimmermann, D-2300 Kiel 14
runtime: uses /r0 for temporary file; may be changed in 'h_def.h'

name: I_AM_I
summary: This program prints it's own source code.
author: Christian Mahr

name: ifdef
purpose: Remove unwanted ifdefs from C source code
summary: IFDEF removes unwanted C code enclosed with '#ifdef', '#else' and '#endif' preprocessor statements. Symbols may be defined and undefined by options. A #define/#undefine table may be printed.
author: Warren Toomey

name: indent
summary: INDENT reformats C source programs to enhance readability. It checks the indentiation of statements and beautifies comments. The reformatting style is controlled by several options.
author: University of California,  Berkeley University of Illinois, Urbana Sun Microsystems, Inc.

name: lharc
summary: files AND directories can be packed into a very good compressed archive
author: Yooichi Tagawa

name: logisim
summary: displays the function of a logical circuit as a pulse diagram an ASCII text file encodes the logical circuit to be simulated
author: Hubert Nehring

name: m4
summary: preprocessor similar to CPP, but with changed syntax and extended functionality.
author: from FREE SOFTWARE FOUNDATION (adaption to OS-9/68k : Stephan Paschedag)

name: remove
summary: removes modules from memory, if possible. remove checkes if the module is removable or not. Wildcards can be used.
author: Stephan Paschedag

name: rxmod/txmod
purpose: load OS9 modules via a serial link
summary: send OS9 Modules via a serial line and make them known in OS9's module directory
author: Werner Wittig, D-6100 Darmstadt

name: sed
summary: SED allows an automatic editing of text files e.g. in shell procedures or pipes. The editing commands are given by a script file or by a string.
author: GNU

name: space
purpose: displays effective disk usage of files/dirs
summary: Shows effective disk usage (contents plus file system overhead) of given directory trees and single files. SPACE provides options to find out if some files will fit on a disk with different cluster size than the source.
author: Lukas Zeller

name: tree
summary: displays sorted directory tree - special graphics for VTxxx terminals.
author: Christian Mahr

name: tree
summary: displays sorted directory tree - special graphics for VTxxx terminals. - special graphics for ATARI ST/IBM terminals.
author: Christian Mahr

name: tree
summary: displays sorted directory tree - special graphics for VTxxx, ATARI ST/IBM and Gepard terminal.
author: Christian Mahr / Helmut Kohl

name: version
summary: program fragment to be added to other programs Displays module edition number as version number of this program
author: Christian Mahr

name: yacc
summary: Very useful for generating lexical parsers. Generates from a description language C-source code.
author: from Berkeley univeristy (adaption to OS-9/68 : Stephan Paschedag)
